messages:
Ana C: Draft: \'Quick Adoption Pulse\' for 0-30d onboarding. Goal: cut renewal risk by focusing on prefill, warmup, and short eval loops. TL;DR below. :seedling:

Sam G: Love it. Add a path for low-DAU tenants (<10% daily active) and a throttled kill-switch for big prefetch jobs.

Ana C: Updated checklist:
- Prefill top 5 intents into prefix cache (TTL 24h)
- Warmup: staggered ramp to 50 reqs/min per tenant first 24h
- Client-side batching cap: 4 requests / 32 tokens max
- Streaming fallback when median p50 > 500ms
- Telemetry: adoption score, sample responses, regression alerts
- Day14/day28 renewal-risk handoff triggers

Jordan (SE): Warmup runner for Dedicated/Private (run from separate control host):
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
    -d '{\"model\":\"xlarge-v1\",\"input\":\"prefill:customer_top_utterances\"}' &
  sleep 1
done
```
Notes: keep concurrency low, spread across AZs, and respect per-tenant throttle flag.

Maria P: I'll make a 1-pager + CSM outreach email. Ops: set alert if adoption_score < 0.15 at day 14.

Sam G: For at-risk tenants: daily QA sampling (5 responses/day), auto-rollback if eval quality drops >5% vs baseline, temporary short-burst prefetch to maintain UX while debugging.

Ana C: In-app feedback survey at day7 (3 questions): output OK? (yes/no), latency issue? (yes/no), blockers? (free text). Keep it tiny.

ops-bot: Template created: /templates/adoption-pulse-v1 by Ana C
